description: Unit test script using pytest for testing search API logging and cost tracking in a proxy module of a software project. The test mocks external services, verifies that search requests generate proper spend logs with correct fields, and checks integration points of logging and spending tracking.

classes.name: SearchResult
classes.description: Represents a search result with title, url, snippet.

classes.name: SearchResponse
classes.description: Encapsulates the response from a search API with object type and results list.

methods.name: test_search_api_logging_and_cost_tracking(prisma_client)
methods.description: Asynchronous test verifying proper logging of search API requests with fields such as call_type, model, provider, spend, and associated metadata. Mocks search responses, invokes internal callbacks, and asserts that spend logs are created correctly.
